name: Gorran Fesk
found: The Barred Door, behind the bar with the axe.
appearance: Big, grey-bearded, an axe hung behind the bar.
and_yet: His hands shake when he pours.
sayings: Door's barred at dusk. In or out.
wants: His brother's body back from the Bramblewood.
does_not_want: Anyone who deals with the dead drinking here.
knows: Which families have lost someone to the wood.
tragedies: His brother Aedd died of fever this spring. Three nights later he walked north into the Bramblewood.
